name: productcatalogservice - GetProduct Error Rate
description: The number of ERROR-status spans on oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct has exceeded the threshold in the last 5 minutes. This operation fails when a product ID lookup fails (rpc.grpc.status_code 13 - INTERNAL), causing the frontend to return HTTP 500 to end users. Investigate whether the productCatalogServiceError feature flag is enabled (intentional fault injection) or whether a malformed product ID is reaching the service.

annotations.runbook:
1. Check whether the productCatalogServiceError feature flag is enabled in featureflagservice — if so, this is intentional fault injection and can be silenced by disabling the flag.
2. Inspect recent GetProduct spans (otel.span.status.code=ERROR) for suspicious app.product.id values, e.g. IDs with a trailing '}' character which indicates a malformed request from the frontend.
3. Trace the call chain: frontend HTTP GET -> grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (CLIENT) -> productcatalogservice SERVER span. The error propagates upward, causing HTTP 500 to the end user.
